biotools.summary: AMDirT is a command-line tool developed by the SPAAM community to facilitate rapid data filtering and downloading of ancient metagenomic data, as well as improving metadata curation. It works in conjunction with AncientMetagenomeDir to provide standardized metadata for ancient metagenomic samples.
